notes.title: Freakshow Episode 3 Release
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Good News Everyone!
Freakshow episode 3 is out, (sorry for the delay) it introduces a lot of new content as well as moving the story forward:

- 6 sex scenes (including threesomes)

- New characters & locations

I hope you'll like it ^^
